caveat: Scripted gold replays of train/dev tasks. Generated-token figures are the lengths of the gold tool calls rendered by the chat template, not a policy output distribution; user turns are fixed placeholders; held-out is not read.
prompt_construction: initial prompt = chat template of build_action_messages(policy, reset observation) with tools=<93 ITSM schemas + done> and the generation prompt; then, as TauAgentLoop concatenates ids, each action adds its generated tokens and each observation adds a newline separator plus one user turn (OBSERVATION_PROMPT) rendered alone with the generation prompt. Re-rendering the whole conversation differs because Qwen3's template drops earlier empty <think> blocks.
observation_rule_note: Every tool result is counted in full, as configs/itsm/budget_v1.yaml requires. unfiltered_read_observations shows single results (largest: 30041 tokens, list_incidents on itsmbench_eops_1d219d93_d1ba6c2d) that can exhaust the response budget; under this rule such an episode ends with truncate('response_length') and keeps the full observation in its trace.
